scan.click_scan.instruction: click the large 'Scan My Network' button at the top center

doc.open.instruction: click the 'Network Discovery Report' entry under 'DOCUMENTS FROM THIS CHAT' near the bottom

share.click.instruction: click the share icon in the top-right corner of the report header

easymode.settings.instruction: click the settings gear icon at the bottom of the far-left rail

easymode.toggle_off.instruction: click the 'Easy mode' toggle to turn it OFF

pickmode.to_pick.instruction: click the Pick (shield) icon in the far-left connector rail

pickmode.menu.instruction: click the hamburger menu icon at the top-left next to the 'Pick' title

pickmode.toggle_off.instruction: click the 'Easy Mode' toggle to turn it off

auth.dismiss_preflight.instruction: click the 'Next' button in the bottom-right corner
